guest: Nothing booked yet, but we'd love one special dinner and time to explore without packing every day. I love Thai home cooking; Tom is happiest photographing gardens and little architectural details.
reply: A special dinner with plenty of unhurried exploring sounds like a good balance. What Thai dishes or flavours do you especially love, and is there anything either of you avoids eating?
